text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mister?
Kyoka and Misogi were talking about a
\"spirit realm,\" but what's that? What kind of place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん、
キョウカちゃんとミソギちゃんが言ってた、
れいかい
って、
なぁに？　
どんなところ？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
All the ghosties live there?
Are there lots of them?
That sounds so fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊さんが住んでるの～？
たくさんいるのかな～
楽しそうだね～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
You've been there?
Wow, mister, you sure do go to a lot of places!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまに行けるの～？
おにいちゃんはいろんなところに行ってて
すごいね～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
If even you don't know, then I don't have a clue!
I wonder what it's like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃんがわからないなら、
ミミにもわからないかも～
なんなんだろうね～？
